capability_graph_law: BUILT requires wired AND accepted. wired is a non-test call of the implementing symbol. accepted is the gate's own acceptance criterion demonstrably met by a receipt or measurement that meets the stated bar, not merely a receipt on the topic. wired alone is WIRED, never BUILT.

counts_explained.SOFTWARE_CONNECTION_REMAINING: the parts exist and nothing calls or checks them
counts_explained.TOTAL_UNRESOLVED_GATES: every gate with any remaining blocker, including hardware
counts_explained.completed_capabilities: gates the auditor calls BUILT: wired AND acceptance-passed, which does NOT require a verifier -- the difference from integrated_capabilities is built_but_no_verifier
counts_explained.integrated_capabilities: gates with NO remaining blocker AND a test citing them

evidence_tier_meaning.FUNCTIONAL_SIM: a real local run of the software, not of the target hardware
evidence_tier_meaning.HARDWARE_MEASURED: measured on the physical device the claim is about
evidence_tier_meaning.LOCAL_MEASURED: measured on this machine, this run, with a retained receipt
evidence_tier_meaning.PROTECTED_VERIFIED: measured under the protected window with contamination controlled
evidence_tier_meaning.REPRODUCED: measured independently more than once, agreeing within a stated bound
evidence_tier_meaning.STATIC: THIS AUDIT established source-level evidence only: definitions, call sites and receipts read out of HEAD blobs. It does NOT mean Hawking has never measured anything physically -- the campaign has produced real wall-clock, throughput and bandwidth measurements, and they live in receipts under receipts/. It means the CAPABILITY GRAPH has not imported them as gate evidence, so no gate may currently claim a physical result.
